graduateCourse.zh: 空间听觉与音频、音乐处理

intro.zh: 曲天书是北京大学智能学院副教授，同时在北京大学国家生物医学成像科学中心开展研究。他的研究领域包括空间听觉、虚拟声音、三维音频场景分析和多通道音频编码。
intro.en: Tianshu Qu is an Associate Professor at the School of Intelligence Science and Technology, Peking University, with an additional affiliation at PKU's National Biomedical Imaging Center. His research covers spatial hearing, virtual sound, 3D audio scene analysis and multichannel audio coding.

homeBackground.zh: 2002年获吉林大学通信与信息系统专业博士学位，随后在北京大学从事博士后研究。2004年起在北大任教，2011—2012年赴密歇根州立大学访学。
homeBackground.en: He received his PhD in Communication and Information Systems from Jilin University in 2002 and completed postdoctoral research at PKU. He joined the PKU faculty in 2004 and visited Michigan State University in 2011–2012.

teachingIntro.zh: 讲授《信号与系统》《机器感知实验》和研究生课程《空间听觉与音频、音乐处理》。
teachingIntro.en: He teaches Signals and Systems, Machine Perception Laboratory, and the graduate course Spatial Hearing and Audio/Music Processing.
